title: Node.js version policy
description: Selects the Node.js release lines that this repository declares and tests. Read by scripts/check-node-version-policy.ts.

policy.description: lts: the primary Node.js version is the newest active LTS major. active-latest: the primary Node.js version is the newest active major, including Current releases.

packageType.description: application: engines.node allows only the primary major. library: engines.node allows several active release lines.

includeAllActiveLts.description: For libraries: include every active LTS major in engines.node.

includeCurrentForLibraries.description: For libraries: also include the active Current major in engines.node.
